solid.$description: Carbon's own $button-primary: Blue 60 (#0f62fe) in all four themes, G100 included. Not $link-primary, which lightens to Blue 40 on the dark themes for text contrast; Carbon keeps its filled primary button the same blue everywhere, so dark mode deliberately carries the light value over.
Carbon's own $button-secondary — a real, named secondary role, unlike GOV.UK: Gray 80 (#393939) on White, Gray 60 (#6f6f6f) on G100.
Carbon's core tokens don't name a 'neutral brand' role either; Gray 60 (#6f6f6f, Carbon's $text-helper/$icon-secondary gray) is the closest authored anchor.

surface.$description: Carbon's own $background-inverse, the surface of its tooltips and inline notifications on the high-contrast side: Gray 80 on White, Gray 10 on G100.

ring.$description: Carbon's own $focus token — another clean 1:1 mapping, and mode-aware out of the box (blue on White, white on G100).

md.$description: Carbon's core structural components (buttons, inputs, tiles) render square by default — a handful of components (tags, tooltips) use a small radius, but there's no single catalog-level radius.md that captures both, so this binds the dominant structural value.
